leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Node.js project with required dependencies for cron scheduling
Configure a cron job using cron syntax to specify execution intervals
Implement a task function that executes at scheduled intervals
Control cron job lifecycle by starting and stopping scheduled tasks
Integrate error handling within cron jobs to manage task execution failures
Manipulate cron patterns to adjust task frequency and timing
Construct a scheduler that manages multiple periodic tasks simultaneously
lessonTitle: Build cron scheduler for periodic tasks
